title: Metal Jig Fishing Lures Set Sinking Hard Fishing Bait Set
description: Stop letting trophy fish stay just out of reach. Engineered for extreme distance and realistic fluid action, this holographic metal jigging spoon set is your ticket to covering more water and triggering aggressive reaction strikes. Whether you are casting from the shore, jigging over deep structures, or working the flats, these versatile micro jigs mimic panicked baitfish to perfection. Featuring an aerodynamic, stream-lined profile, this sinking hard fishing bait set cuts through heavy winds, letting you achieve maximum distance on every single launch. Why Serious Anglers Keep This Jig Kit in Their Tackle Box: Extreme Long-Casting Performance: Designed with a rear-weighted, aerodynamic profile that maximizes momentum for unmatched distance, making it the ultimate setup for bank and shore fishermen. Irresistible Sinking Action: Drops with a erratic, high-frequency flutter on the fall, remaining in the strike zone longer to entice finicky bass, trout, walleye, and perch. Specifications: Bait Type: Sinking Metal Jig / Jigging Spoon / Micro Spoon Weight Variations: Available in 7g (45mm), 10g (48mm), 15g (55mm), 20g (60mm), and 25g (65mm) Hook Setup: 1 x Feathered Assist Single Hook (Front) + 1 x High-Carbon Steel Treble Hook (Rear) Target Species: Bass (Largemouth & Smallmouth), Trout, Perch, Crappie, Pike, Walleye, Stripers, and more. Environment: Formulated for freshwater streams and lakes, as well as light saltwater coastal fishing.
